meta.title: 画面很平，要学会“破”一下
meta.title_en: Flat Frames? Learn to Break Them

scenes.title_cn: 核心命题：画面平淡、排版呆板怎么办？…
scenes.title_en: Core idea: flat frames and stiff layouts? …
scenes.context: 基于图文实录的剪辑与呈现处理重构。
sentences: 画面太平淡、排版太呆板，缺乏设计感。
Flat frames and stiff layouts lack design flair.
lack design flair（缺设计感）
大胆打破现有画面秩序才有设计感。
Boldly breaking the existing order creates design flair.
break the order（打破秩序）
scenes.speak: Flat frames and stiff layouts lack design flair. Boldly breaking the existing order creates design flair.

scenes.title_cn: 五种「破」的手法：一是用线条分割普通…
scenes.title_en: Five ways to break: split a plain image wi…
sentences: 一张普通图片，用线条分割，就有设计感。
Split a plain image with a line and it instantly has design flair.
split with a line（线条分割）
呆板排版上划一刀，就有节奏感。
Slash a stiff layout and it gains rhythm.
gains rhythm（节奏感）
拘谨画面冲出一条边界，就有呼吸感。
Push one element past the boundary for breathing room.
break the boundary（冲出边界）
普通标题打破原有排列，变醒目。
Break a plain title's arrangement to make it pop.
make it pop（变醒目）
单调元素替换成有深度的，就有层次感。
Replace a dull element with a deeper one for layers.
add layers（层次感）
paraphrase: split with a line（线条分割
split with a line（线条分割
scenes.speak: Split a plain image with a line and it instantly has design flair. Slash a stiff layout and it gains rhythm. Push one element past the boundary for breathing room. Break a plain title's arrangement to make it pop. Replace a dull element with a deeper one for layers.

scenes.title_cn: 常见误区与行动：用堆砌代替打破是误区…
scenes.title_en: Common mistake and action: substituting st…
scenes.context: 从堆砌到打破的思维转变。
sentences: 常见误区是用堆砌代替打破。
The common mistake is stacking instead of breaking.
stacking vs breaking（堆砌vs打破）
当你想再加点什么的时候，先问自己能不能打破什么。
When you want to add more, first ask what you can break.
ask what to break（问能否打破）
下次觉得画面平淡时，先尝试分割，用一条线或色块把画面切开。
When the frame feels flat, try splitting it with a line or color block.
split the frame（分割画面）
让一个关键元素冲出画面边界，制造呼吸感和张力。
Let a key element cross the boundary for breathing room and tension.
cross the boundary（冲出边界）
paraphrase: ask what to break（问能否打破
ask what to break（问能否打破
scenes.speak: The common mistake is stacking instead of breaking. When you want to add more, first ask what you can break. When the frame feels flat, try splitting it with a line or color block. Let a key element cross the boundary for breathing room and tension.

practice: Split a plain image with a line.
Slash the stiff layout for rhythm.
Push one element past the frame.
Break the title's arrangement to pop.
pitfalls: Ask what you can break instead.
想加东西时先问能不能打破什么。
Let a key element cross the boundary.
关键元素冲出边界才有张力。
Split, slash, and offset with purpose.
分割、错位要有设计目的。
Swap dull elements for deeper ones.
替换元素要引入深度与层次。
shifts: 用 flat（平淡）、stiff（呆板）、no design flair（缺设计感）
用 split（分割）、slash（划一刀）、break the grid（打破网格）
用 rhythm（节奏感）、breathing room（呼吸感）、depth（层次感）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播（口播极短，场景依据图文实录画面与SVG分析重构）。已校正：画面平、排版呆板、线条分割、划一刀、冲出边界、打破标题、替换元素、节奏感、呼吸感、层次感、堆砌代替打破等。
